envelope.description: Hand the ISSUE's hash to the next stage

body.title: Hand the ISSUE's hash to the next stage
body.summary: nextAfterIssue puts issue.meta.issueHash in the small build call (standalone.epicHash) and the sized design.story call (params.epicHash), and refuses an ISSUE without a 16-hex issueHash.
acceptanceChecks: A small ISSUE's advance call carries standalone.epicHash equal to the ISSUE hash.
A sized ISSUE's advance call carries params.epicHash equal to the ISSUE hash.
An ISSUE without a valid issueHash makes the advance fail.

tests.name: nextAfterIssue: a small ISSUE routes to build with the ISSUE hash as standalone.epicHash
nextAfterIssue: a sized ISSUE routes to design.story with params.epicHash set to the ISSUE hash
nextAfterIssue: an ISSUE without a 16-hex issueHash is refused
